verses.text: Ix ochxi smul heb' israel t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj chi' 40 ab'il ix ak'ji'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo yuj.
Ha t'a chonhab' Zora, t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Dan, ay jun winh skuchan Manoa. Ha ix yetb'eyum winh, malaj yune' ix, yujto max unewilaj ix.
Ix sch'ox sb'a Yángel Jehová t'a ix, ix yalani: --Ha ach tik wal yel malajtaxon junok une' ix il sat. Palta a tikne'ik, ol a kuchkanoch une', ol aljok jun a winak unin.
Ayik ol b'eyb'at tik, manhxo uk'laj wino, manhxo uk'paxlaj junok tas pajb'inak. Manhxo a chipaxlaj tas ay yowalil t'a yichanh ley.
Ayik ol aljok jun une' chi', manh ol joxji'el-laj xil sjolom, yujto nazareo ol ajok, yujto yik Dios yaji ayik manto aljok. A' ol cha'anel yich ex skolanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo, xchi t'a ix.

Ix b'at ix b'aj ayek' winh yetb'eyum, ix yalan ix t'a winh: Ay jun schekab' Dios ix ulek' b'aj ayin ek'i. Ix te sat in k'o'ol yuj, icha wal to Yángel Dios ix wila'. Maj in k'anb'ejlaj t'ay b'ajtil ix koti, maj yalpaxlaj sb'i t'ayin.

Anhej to ix yal t'ayin, tob' ol aljok junok wune'. Ix yalani to manhxo ol wuk'laj wino yet' junokxo tas pajb'inak yet' junok tas to ay yowalil ko chi'an t'a yichanh ley. Axob' jun unin chi', tob' yik Dios yaji ayik ol aljok chi', masanto ol chamok, xchi ix.

Yuj chi' ix lesalwi winhaj Manoa chi' t'a Jehová icha tik: Mamin, elok wal t'a a k'o'ol to tza chekxikot a chekab' chi' t'ayonh, yik wach' ol yal t'ayonh tas wal ol ko k'ulej yet' jun unin ol aljok chi', xchi winh.
Ix yab' Dios tas ix sk'an winh chi', ix sch'oxanxi sb'a Yángel Jehová chi' t'a ix yetb'eyum winh chi' ayik wan yik'an yip ix t'a kal munlajel, palta manh ayokek'laj winhaj Manoa chi' ta' yet' ix.
Elanhchamel ix b'at lemnaj ix yal t'a winh: --Lemach, yujto ix sch'oxxi sb'a jun chekab' t'ayin, jun ul lolon t'ayin t'a junel, xchi ix.

Ix kot lemnaj winhaj Manoa chi', ix b'at winh yet' ix yetb'eyum chi', ix k'och winh b'aj ayek' Yángel Jehová chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'ay: --¿Tom a ach tik ul ach ek' lolonel t'a ix wetb'eyum tik t'a junel? xchi winh t'ay. --I', a in toni, xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anb'anxi winh t'ay: --Ayik ol elk'och tas ix al chi', ¿tas wal ol kutej kilan k'ib' winh unin chi' yet' tas yopisio winh? xchi winh t'ay.
Ix tak'wi Yángel Jehová chi': --Yowalil sk'anab'ajej ix etb'eyum tik tas ix wala':

Jantaknhej tas skot t'a sat te' uwa, manhxo ol slolaj ix. Mokab' yuk' wino ix yet' junokxo tas pajb'inak, ma tas ay yowalil schiji t'a yichanh ley. Ha tas ix wal chi' t'a ix, yowalil sk'anab'ajej ix, xchi t'a winh.

Ha winhaj Manoa chi', manh yojtakok winh tato Yángel Jehová jun chi', yuj chi' ix yal winh: --Swal t'ayach, komonok tz'el t'a a k'o'ol tzonh a tanhwej, tik b'at ko b'o junok nok' yune' chiwa a chi'a, xchi winh t'ay. Ix tak'wi jun Ángel chi': --Wach'chom tzin kan heyet'ok, palta manh ol in walaj. Syal eyak'an nok' chi' silab'il t'a Jehová, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Manoa chi' t'ay icha tik: --Alkan a b'i t'ayonh yik wach' ayik tz'elk'och tas ix ul alkan tik t'ayonh, ol kak' yuj diosal t'ayach, xchi winh t'ay.
Ix tak'wi Ángel chi' t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj tze k'anb'ej in b'i chi'? Ha jun chi' te satub'tak yochi, xchi.

Ix yik'ankot nok' chiwa winhaj Manoa chi' yet' juntzanh ixim sat trigo t'a ofrenda'il. Ix snhusantz'a silab' winh t'a Jehová t'a yib'anh jun k'e'en k'e'en. Ixlajwi chi', ix sch'oxan jun milagro Jehová t'a yichanh winh yet' ix yetb'eyum chi'.
Ayik ix k'e nhilnaj k'ak' t'a yib'anh altar chi', ix och Yángel Jehová chi' t'a skal k'ak' chi', ix paxk'e'i. Ayik ix yilan heb' icha chi', ix em kumnaj heb', ix em nhojan heb' t'a sat lu'um.
Ichato chi' ix nachajel yuj winhaj Manoa chi' to Yángel Jehová jun chi'. Majxo sch'oxlaj sb'a junelxo t'a winh yet' t'a ix yetb'eyum winh chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a ix yetb'eyum chi' icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik t'a wal yel ol onh chamok, yujto ix kil wal och Dios, xchi winh t'a ix.
Ix tak'wi ix t'a winh icha tik: --Tato snib'ej Jehová to tzonh chami, maj am scha ko silab' ix kak' t'ay yet' kofrenda, maj am sch'ox juntzanh tik kila', maj am yal juntzanh tik t'ayonh, xchi ix.
Ayik ix alji yune' ix chi', Sansón ix yak' ix sb'i'ej. Ix k'ib' winh unin chi', ix yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh winh.
Ix scha'anel yich sch'oxan sb'a Yespíritu Jehová t'a winh ayik ayek' winh t'a scampamento heb' yinhtilal Dan, t'a skal chonhab' Zora yet' Estaol.
